thread:
sam: Quick heads-up — ACME POC ready to kickoff but legal pulled redlines on the MSA/DPA and finance is asking whether we need a PO vs invoice for the pilot. Need alignment on signing fallback so we don't block the start.
priya: Which redlines specifically? link pls.
sam: Short list: subprocessor disclosure, SLA bumped from 99.5 -> 99.9, request for exec-only signature, and they insist on PO before any charge. Also pricing question — can we cap pilot spend? PO examples normally look like `PO#: ACME-2026-001`.
eden_legal: Quick read — we can provide a subprocessor list + SOC2 attestation. SLA: hosted API we usually keep 99.5; Dedicated can be 99.9 with a commit. Exec-only signature: we can allow delegated signers if they provide a delegation letter on company letterhead.
marta_finance: For pilots: finance policy = invoice ok if total <= $10,000. If they insist on PO, they must issue prior to billing. Net30 is standard. GL code for pilots: `4401`.
priya: Customer wants e-sign via HelloSign and to designate `procurement@acme.com` as delegated signer — can we accept that?
signing-bot: Automated: signature workflow requires 1x legal + 1x finance approval for non-standard delegation. Attachments (delegation letter) required. :eyes:
eden_legal: We need the delegation letter or proof of signatory authority. If they can’t provide it, require exec signature. Also request a short data flow diagram for subprocessor mapping.
sam: If we can't get final MSA done before kickoff, can we ship a short SOW to start?
eden_legal: Yes — SOW + short Terms Addendum referencing the MSA terms is acceptable. Make it clear the SOW is limited to pilot scope and cap, and MSA must be executed within 30 days or services pause. Need product to approve the capped credit amount.
jordan: From SE: we can cap pilot credits to $7,500 and pin model versions to avoid drift. No infra blockers on our side for the pilot SLA (we'll note expected latencies).
marta_finance: If we go SOW + invoice route, I can accept a one-time invoice to start; I'll need the customer billing contact and PO/approval reference to reconcile.
sam: I'll draft the email to ACME and attach temporary SOW. @eden_legal @marta_finance — can you both confirm the wording for the delegation clause and invoice terms so I can send?
eden_legal: I'll draft the delegation clause and DPA addendum language. We can provide a redacted subprocessor list and SOC2 summary.
marta_finance: I'll confirm invoice language (Net30, remit-to, GL `4401`) and approve the one-time invoice path for <$10k.
sam: Thanks — I'll route the SOW now and ask for delegation letter + billing contact. Ticket: #POC-4721. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Deploybot: SOW template (pilot-term-addendum-v1) uploaded to #docs and attached here for review.
priya: I'll schedule a 15-min sync with ACME to clarify PO vs invoice and the delegation process.
signing-bot: Note: if delegation letter received, tag `eden_legal` + `marta_finance` for automated sign-off checklist.
sam: Perfect — will update thread with customer's attachments.
